title: Embedding binary decision trees
statement: For any finite set of available coordinates, a decision tree whose queries have two children, labelled by the bit values $0$ and $1$, determines a decision tree over the alphabet $ br/ br?$. Here the child for $0$ is selected when the queried value is zero, and the child for $1$ otherwise.
hypotheses_covered: A finite set of available coordinates
caveat: The alphabet is the two-element ring ZMod 2, not a real quotient; the statement should read ZMod 2 rather than the malformed notation in this draft.
